thought.text: The simple production boot works. The earlier failure was in my multi-line probe. Let me isolate which secret lookup fails:

reasoning_content: Interesting — the simple runner succeeded. The earlier failure might have been caused by `Rails.application.secrets.secret_key_base` or something in that chain. Let's check which part failed.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && RAILS_ENV=production timeout 300 bin/rails runner '
s = Rails.application.secrets
puts "sk set: " + !s.secret_key_base.blank?.to_s
begin
  puts "server_name: " + s.server_name.to_s
rescue => e
  puts "server_name err: " + e.class.to_s + " " + e.message
end
' 2>&1 | head -8
